instruction: Visualize a hollow luminous column roughly in the center of your back. With every in-breath and out-breath it becomes more awake and energized.

lockedSpine.placement: posterior anatomical spine: base of skull, rear neck curve, close inside the back contour, ending at the rear sacrum
lockedSpine.vertebraTreatment: small articulated cervical units, numerous thoracic units, broader lumbar units, and a tapered fused-looking sacral/coccygeal ending
lockedSpine.spiritualTreatment: warm-gold and white core, translucent amber edges, restrained cyan-violet aura, and tiny local energy motes
lockedSpine.animationMethod: fixed overlay with opacity-only glow progression
lockedSpine.isolation: source-colored articulated core and local source-colored aura; former body silhouette excluded

preview.breathingPattern: quick stepped illumination from sacrum to skull base, one full-column pixel-glow pulse, then the exact reverse illumination on exhale

breathSequence.exhaleDirection: skull base to sacrum using the same frames in reverse
breathSequence.lightTransition: 60-pixel feathered reveal with smoothstep easing so adjacent vertebrae blend rather than pop

bodyMotion.method: fixed original master with targeted outline-pixel repair
bodyMotion.motion: the body remains registered and still; the locked spine illumination carries the inhale and exhale
bodyMotion.registration: exact original 1254 by 1254 canvas, silhouette, seated baseline, and horizontal anchor
bodyMotion.colorPolicy: every non-target RGB pixel preserved byte-for-byte; replacements use guide colors or original-palette navy

breathSequence.powerEffect: one full-column pulse with matched stepped halos flowing inward and outward around both sides of the spine, then settling before reversal

constraints: The side-upright male avatar is the visual master.
The avatar remains upright with the same proportions, registration, and pixel-art detail.
The hollow amber-gold column uses one locked shape and one locked position in every frame; only glow opacity changes.
The chest remains free of chakra symbols and other markers.

appRegistration.method: one shared CSS transform on the animation element; every frame receives the exact same registration
appRegistration.target: canonical male side-upright solid-pixel height, horizontal center, and seated baseline
